Chapter 837: Chapter 31: Anticipation (Please Subscribe)

“Why do I feel like I’m facing another ultimate being?”

Xia Qin, the supreme being, was shocked. This was the perception of the supreme beings, emerging only when facing existences of the same level.

When Xia Qin, the supreme being, interacted with eight other supreme beings, this perception emerged.

It also came forth when negotiating with other ultimate alien races.

But now?

Lin Yuan?

...

A young lad who has just entered the Tenth Rank?

Could it actually give Xia Qin, the supreme being, a similar feeling?

If it weren’t for Xia Qin, the supreme being, experiencing this himself, he wouldn’t believe it at all.

It’s ridiculous.

“What’s the reason?”

“Spiritual will? Galaxy Master’s spiritual will surpasses the threshold of eighteen million mind will index points, no, it’s not just surpassing; it is far beyond.”

Xia Qin, the supreme being’s mind operated incredibly fast, immediately speculating the most likely reason.

Firstly, this is the Virtual World, whether it be Lin Yuan or Xia Qin, the supreme being.

It is all a manifestation of a trace of spiritual will.

Secondly, this place is the personal world of Xia Qin, the supreme being. Without permission, even other supreme beings can’t use any power here.

That is to say, the feeling Lin Yuan gives to Xia Qin, the supreme being, originates entirely from the intensity of spiritual will.

Only when one’s spiritual will steps into the level of supreme beings can it give Xia Qin, the supreme being, such a feeling.

But Lin Yuan?

Spiritual will strength of a supreme being?

Xia Qin, the supreme being, suddenly didn’t know how to describe it.

A Tenth Rank lifeform? Possessing the spiritual will strength of a supreme being?

Can that still be called a Tenth Rank lifeform?

Xia Qin, the supreme being, fell silent.

“Supreme being?” Lin Yuan also noticed Xia Qin, the supreme being’s repeated scrutinizing gaze.

Under normal circumstances, when he came to visit Xia Qin, the supreme being, the latter would have already started asking what the matter was.

“It seems he has felt my spiritual will strength,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

It was inevitable given that Lin Yuan’s spiritual will had reached the Twelfth Rank, but ultimately, he was still at the Tenth Rank and could not perfectly conceal it in front of a supreme being.

Even if he hadn’t come to visit Xia Qin, the supreme being, before the breakthrough to the Eleventh Rank, the supreme being incarnation would discover it when it descended.

“Your spiritual will, has it surpassed twenty million index points?”

After a moment of silence, Xia Qin, the supreme being, began to ask directly.

Spiritual will indexes, once they exceed ten million points, become very difficult to quantify specifically.

Xia Qin, the supreme being, only felt that Lin Yuan’s spiritual will index had definitely reached the Twelfth Rank level, and it wasn’t just at the basic entry level.

“About.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

In fact, his spiritual will index had reached thirty-three million three hundred forty thousand points, but that too falls under the category of surpassing twenty million.

“You…”

Having received confirmation from Lin Yuan, Xia Qin, the supreme being didn’t know how to respond.

A monstrosity.

Absolutely monstrous.

Merely at the Tenth Rank, yet in the domain of spiritual will, stepping into the Twelfth Rank, can a human evolver really achieve this?

Compared to other talents and aptitudes, spiritual will is the least susceptible to shortcuts. The unique special lives in the universe, with their exceedingly noble bloodlines, what about spiritual will?

It still requires starting from scratch. A powerful physical soul, the spiritual will it cultivates will indeed be stronger, but certainly not with as much advantage as in the physical soul domain.

“I had a seclusion some time ago, where I gained some insights in spiritual will.”

Lin Yuan offered the reason he had prepared.

The enhancement of spiritual will, aside from its gradual increase through extended age, can also be boosted in a short time through ‘epiphanies.’

Here, ‘epiphanies’

are the sudden insights into the operations of the universe and all things within it.

However, such events are rare and, since the creation of the universe, have not occurred frequently, and even when they do, it is usually among life forms of lower ranks.

For example, a Fourth Rank or Fifth Rank life form, occasionally has an epiphany, and their spiritual will index jumps from a few hundred to a few thousand?

Certain native lives on Barbaric Wilderness Planets, without undergoing any evolutionary cultivation, have a spiritual will index nearing ten thousand?

But for someone like Lin Yuan, after an ‘epiphany’, to have the spiritual will index directly surpass twenty million points, probably has never happened before.

“Epiphany…”

Xia Qin, the supreme being, once again fell silent, vaguely guessing that the significant rise in Lin Yuan’s spiritual will was probably not as simple as an epiphany.

Because the increase was too substantial.

Nevertheless, that was Lin Yuan’s own secret, and Xia Qin, the supreme being, would not interfere.

Since Lin Yuan stepped into the Tenth Rank, causing the Chaos Void Origin Infusion, and thereafter tearing open a cosmic rift measured by light-years.

Xia Qin, the supreme being, knew Lin Yuan had his own remarkable encounters.

Regarding these, Xia Qin, the supreme being wouldn’t even ask.

“Spiritual will… the stronger, the better.”

After much thought, Xia Qin, the supreme being, slowly began.

The higher the rank of the evolver, the more they could feel the importance of spiritual will.

Evolutionaries from the First Rank to the Fifth and Sixth Rank probably don’t even know about spiritual will.

But starting from the Seventh Rank, especially when breaking through to the Eighth Rank.

One of the prerequisites is that the spiritual will index reaches ten thousand points.

Only then can one confidently surpass the Heart Demon tribulation.

From the Eighth Rank onwards, the influence of spiritual will grows continuously; by the Eleventh Rank, when striking for the ultimate, it necessitates a spiritual will index of ten million points.

In fact, the importance of spiritual will goes far beyond this.

Whether it be human civilization’s Eleventh Rank evolvers or other alien races’ Eleventh Rank powerhouses, their physical souls will no longer decay.

But why do they still seek to extend their lifespan by slowing down the flow of time?
